user_request: Reduce emphasis of designed sequence edits; strengthen real variant biological application with useful and traceable cases.
status: Exploratory case-selection plan, not preregistration or independent confirmation. All original outputs/labels previously exposed.
question: Can an exact natural human variant have different source-preferred alleles for different RBPs, and do frozen CARBON predictions recover those distinctions? At particular events, does the aligned conservation input agree with measured direction where sequence-only or fixed-input controls fail?
population: All7262 existing qualified BEAPR ASB-positive events /4669 variants; inspect full pool and strict chr8/15 separately. All13 clinical/tumor events remain separately complete. No new exclusion from global endpoints.
source_first_priority: Exact variant/cell/strand; identical reference101 and Phi across grouped RBP events.
Unambiguous single gene for main-case interpretation, source FDR<0.1 retained; stronger FDR noted as confidence, not effect size.
Prefer at least3 distinct RBPs and both REF- and ALT-preferred events to expose RBP-specific allele judgments beyond a constant REF rule.
Strict396 subset preferred for display, with prior developmental exposure explicitly retained. Training/validation cases labelled if used.
outcome_aware_selection: After source eligibility, order candidate illustrations by Full-minus-Sequence number of correct source directions, then Full-minus-fixed-control minimum gain, then RBP coverage, source confidence and lexical variant ID. Complete candidate census and all events per selected locus must be saved. No selected-subset performance or statistical significance is promoted as population evidence.
minimum_display_margin: Flag near-zero predictions; main highlighted Full-versus-control disagreement should exceed1e-3 log-count units on both sides when feasible. This is a computational display/stability filter, not an assay effect-size threshold.
controls: Full, historical Sequence, fixed Full with flat Phi, all3 saved Phi permutations and their mean; constant genomic REF preference. Training histories Full/Sequence are not matched/verified.
evidence_limits: ASB-positive only: no detection AUROC/AP or variant-prioritization accuracy.
Source normalized major/minor fields identify preferred alleles; raw counts and FDR are not calibrated binding-effect magnitudes.
RBP/task events, contexts and variants are different units; no individual-case p-value or new bootstrap.
Allele-specific association alone does not isolate the causal focal SNV from linked haplotype variation.
ClinVar and singleton TCGA annotations provide context, not an independent RBP-binding or disease mechanism endpoint.
ReferencePhi is fixed for both alleles; no mutant evolutionary score.
Clinical complete subset remains Full7/13 versus Sequence10/13. Original396 macro results and negative Phi intervals remain unchanged.
new_experiment: None launched. If isolated-variant functional validation is required, define an independent assay/control/endpoint/budget proposal before execution.

reporter_addendum.source: Yang et al.2019 Nature Communications10:1338, doi:10.1038/s41467-019-09292-w
reporter_addendum.availability: All11 two-allele reporter loci in original Figures4e/5e/6c; all24 qualified existing ASB events at exact loci;66 biological measurements. No new predictions or assays.
reporter_addendum.matching: Both mutagenesis primers exactly match reference/alternate101 windows including focal position50, with direct/reverse-complement orientation recorded. UBE2I alternative C primer inferred from published C/G and verified against original hg19chr16:1374951 and both frozen allele windows; only G primer supplied. Source typo SCL39A13 is normalized explicitly to SLC39A13.
reporter_addendum.main_selection: ACVR1B selected posthoc for a single-RBP expression-reporter locus where Full agrees with ASB and Sequence/flat/permutation mean disagree; individual perm2 also agrees and is displayed. CERS2 selected for exact GWAS rs267738 plus published isolated-allele splicing and GEMIN5-KD support; Full and Sequence agree for GEMIN5, and complete locus YBX3 Full failure displayed. No selected-case success estimate.
reporter_addendum.not_established: CARBON does not predict the reporter expression/splicing measurement and no direct quantitative model-to-phenotype endpoint or RBP-mediated causality test is computed. All source ASB/model labels exposed; training chromosomes remain labelled.
